correctness.rationale: Invariant exactness gives the coarse weighted quotient and degree720. The full projective eigenspace classification, including the two four-cycle cases and absence of fixed projective points for three or fewer invariant cycles, gives all eleven fixed-locus rows. Effective Cartier divisor degree and discriminant factorization give precisely the fifteen reduced conics and doubled genus-four curves; the finite quotient stabilizer criterion yields precisely two branch components with inertia2. Symbolic checker confirms polynomial identities, resultants and Euler consistency; argument is universal, not based on samples.

value.rationale: Provides the complete branch stratification of a natural degree720 quotient attached to a newly studied sextic normal form. The additional branch away from polynomial root collisions matters for geometric monodromy and for interpreting non-well-formed weighted quotients, and the fifteen conics and full eleven-class table make it a natural complete geometric classification, not a routine isolated numerical calculation.
